items.source: SourceFilter for providing includes and excludes. Using these helps in reducing the amount of data that is returned from Elasticsearch especially when the stored documents are large and only some fields from these documents are needed. If the SourceFilter includes the name of a property that has a different name mapped in Elasticsearch (see Field.name() this will automatically be mapped.
items.translation: SourceFilter 用于提供包含和排除功能。使用它可以减少从 Elasticsearch 返回的数据量，特别是在存储的文档较大且仅需部分字段时尤为有效。如果 SourceFilter 包含了在 Elasticsearch 中映射了不同名称的属性名（参见 Field.name()），该属性将自动被映射。

items.source: Flag to set the _source parameter in a query to true or false.
items.translation: 设置查询中_source 参数为 true 或 false 的标志。

items.source:
Flag to set the _source parameter in a query to true or false. If this is not null, the values returned from
getIncludes() and getExcludes() are ignored
items.translation: 设置查询中_source 参数的标志，值为 true 或 false。如果该值不为 null，则忽略 getIncludes() 和 getExcludes() 返回的值。
乔恩·西罗斯，彼得 - 约瑟夫·迈施

items.source: the name of the fields to include in a response.
items.translation: 响应中要包含的字段名称。

items.source: the names of the fields to exclude from a response.
items.translation: 要排除在响应中的字段名称。
